name: CWP
levelNote: A 6-hour practical against a wireless range in which at least four of five access points must be compromised, followed by a 24-hour window to submit a write-up explaining how each was taken. Scored well above OSWP: it runs longer, requires a report where OSWP does not, sets a higher bar at four of five, and examines WPA3, PMKID and enterprise EAP attacks that the older syllabus predates. Held level with PNPT rather than above it — the cut line is harder but the scope is one discipline against a five-day full-network engagement. Every candidate receives written feedback whether they pass or fail. The 202-lesson course is bundled with the exam voucher and carries intermediate weight. Exam-only score 46, +9 for the training.

cost.note: Course and exam voucher sold together; the voucher expires one year after purchase.
